base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cavernous chamber so comprehensively grey that even the shadows are grey, with a reinforced steel cage at its centre. Lighting: cold flat grey light, a single spotlight on the cage.
In the shot: Princess Holly, a tiny fairy princess about the height of a teacup, with a shimmering fairy-pink dress, iridescent wings like soap bubbles that catch the light, a little silver tiara, rosy cheeks, and a slender wand that fizzes with small irregular pink sparks.
Camera: Close on Holly, then wide on the cage.
Action: Holly screws up her face, concentrating very hard; her wand charges with pink light — KABOOM — a blinding pink flash fills the chamber.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: wand charging whine, KABOOM, magical shimmer, cosy chimney puff, ambience of low hum, squirrel chittering echoing.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Princess Holly).
Action: The light clears: the cage has become an exquisite gingerbread house with iced windows, a marzipan door, a roof of chocolate buttons and a chimney puffing cinnamon-scented steam.
No dialogue.
Sound effects continue: wand charging whine, KABOOM, magical shimmer, cosy chimney puff.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
